question: How can Dhruva attain fixedness while perceiving this unfixed world?
premises: This world is observed as not fixed.
Dhruva is the one who sees this world.
Attaining fixedness is questioned despite perceiving impermanence.
inference: The apparent fixedness of Dhruva stands in tension with the unfixed nature of the world he perceives.
plain_english: Seeing this unfixed world, did that Dhruva not attain fixedness?
